summary: The PR addresses the issue of incorrect parsing of composite units in CDS format files by modifying the grammar rules and handling multiple divisions correctly.

issues.description: The added code for handling denominators could be simplified and made more readable. For example, the conversion of negative powers to positive could be done more succinctly.

The new test files (`reproduce_error.py`, `test_edge_cases.py`) are not placed in a conventional test directory structure and are not part of the test suite. They should be moved to an appropriate location within the test directory and included in the test suite.
